evals.prompt: Use {context_root} as the alternative Context root for this request. @context atlas
evals.expected_output: Inspect atlas and briefly orient the user without writing or changing the chat directory. Use the direct entrypoint fast path when catalogue and topic agree.
assertions: Reads the root instructions/catalogue and atlas README and applicable instructions.
Does not change any saved files or the chat working directory.
Does not run complete discovery or load unrelated subjects when the topic is unambiguous.

evals.prompt: Load @context atlas from {context_root} and continue work there. Do not make any project changes yet.
evals.expected_output: Read atlas orientation and recent changelog, verify its configured project directory, and adopt that directory without changing files.
assertions: Reads atlas README, applicable instructions and recent CHANGELOG entries.
Verifies the configured atlas project directory with pwd using that workdir and adopts it for subsequent work.
Does not edit files, run stored diagnostics or scan unrelated subjects.
Does not require or create a project CHANGELOG outside the selected Context collection after adopting the project working directory.

evals.prompt: Use {context_root} as the Context root. Save this verified finding under atlas: the offline parser accepts an empty input and returns an empty list. This was checked today in the fixture project. Do not switch this chat's working directory.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the existing save destination with complete discovery, save the finding in atlas README.md or notes.md with a linked changelog update, and preserve both the chat directory and atlas's saved directory.
assertions: Performs complete destination discovery before saving and reuses atlas rather than creating a competing topic.
Saves only the supplied finding with appropriate provenance and updates atlas CHANGELOG with links.
Preserves the original chat directory and the existing saved atlas working-directory mapping.
Does not change unrelated subjects or claim to have independently executed the parser check.
Updates only the collection topic changelog; does not create or update a CHANGELOG in the linked project outside the collection.

evals.prompt: Load @context missing-project from {context_root} and get ready to work on its project.
evals.expected_output: Load available topic orientation, report that its configured directory is missing, preserve the current directory and ask for a replacement before project work.
assertions: Reads available missing-project orientation and recent changelog.
Reports the unavailable configured directory and does not claim that a working-directory switch succeeded.
Asks for a replacement before project work; does not create or clone the project, change the saved mapping or edit context.

evals.prompt: Load the Context collection itself from {context_root} and use that root as this chat's working directory.
evals.expected_output: Read root instructions and catalogue, verify and adopt the root, and stop after root-level orientation without loading all subjects or requiring a changelog.
assertions: Reads root AGENTS.md and README.md and verifies the root with pwd using that workdir.
Adopts the requested root as the chat directory without editing files or saving a directory setting.
Does not load every subject, perform a full-tree topic search or require/create a root or subject changelog.

evals.prompt: Inspect the Context collection at {context_root} and tell me what the catalogue covers. Do not load it or switch directories.
evals.expected_output: Answer from root instructions/catalogue without changing the chat directory or loading individual projects.
assertions: Reads the root instructions/catalogue and describes their scope.
Keeps the initial chat working directory and all saved files unchanged.
Does not treat inspection as a root-level load or open every project.

evals.expected_output: Report the explicitly named missing entrypoint and do not silently substitute the existing hardware/atlas topic or create a topic.
assertions: Checks the explicit hardware/absent target and reports that its entrypoint is missing.
Does not substitute hardware/atlas, create a directory or edit context.
Leaves the current chat working directory unchanged and does not claim a successful load.

evals.prompt: Use {context_root} as the Context root. Inspect the topic called radio; I am not sure whether that means the networking notes or the music notes.
evals.expected_output: Broaden read-only discovery and show the competing scopes, then ask which topic is intended without switching or writing.
assertions: Broadens discovery beyond a single catalogue match and identifies both plausible radio scopes.
Explains the scope difference and asks the user to select before loading or writing.
Keeps saved files and the chat directory unchanged; does not use Git history as current topic evidence.

evals.prompt: Use {context_root}/absent-collection as the alternative Context root. Save this finding under atlas: the offline parser accepts empty input. Do not use any other collection.
evals.expected_output: Report that the selected root is unavailable and stop before choosing or writing a destination; do not fall back to live Context or create the collection.
assertions: Checks the explicitly selected root and reports that it does not exist.
Does not read the live collection, silently use a different root or create the requested root.
Leaves the chat directory and all fixture files unchanged; does not claim the finding was saved.

evals.prompt: Use {context_root} as the Context root. Inspect the saved topic synthetic-wombat, if it exists.
evals.expected_output: Discover that this name appears only in infrastructure test examples, not a real saved topic. Explain that limitation without loading or creating it.
assertions: Uses the selected root explicitly for discovery and distinguishes test-example matches from subject evidence.
Does not select .skills/example/evals as a canonical topic or treat synthetic-wombat as an established saved subject.
Leaves saved files and the chat directory unchanged and reports no verified topic entrypoint.
